ValidationRule.description: Audit user cannot be the same as the Data Entry Owner or the Case Assigned To
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (Data_Entry_Owner__c = Audit_Assigned_To__c && NOT(ISBLANK(Data_Entry_Owner__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Audit_Assigned_To__c))) || (Case_Assigned_To__c = Audit_Assigned_To__c && NOT(ISBLANK(Case_Assigned_To__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Audit_Assigned_To__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Audit cannot be the same as the Data Entry or Contract Assigned To owners within the case.
